text:
devon: Heads-up — planning Q3 capacity strategy. Want to push spot/preemptible for batch workloads but keep interactive endpoints on dedicated. High-level goal: target ~60-70% spot for non-latency-critical jobs, improve interruption handling so we don't waste GPU time. Thoughts?

sophie: +1. My initial plan: per-region two pools — `dedicated` (small baseline for interactive, always warm) and `spot-burst` (autoscale). Use node labels + taints so only batch jobs land on spot. Expect ~65% cost savings on batch if we tolerate preempts.

kai: Interruption handling is key. Recommend: 1) checkpoint long-running batch to S3/GS every N minutes, 2) use a small sidecar that listens for SIGTERM/Preempt signal and uploads state, 3) quick requeue into batch-lowprio queue. Example handler snippet we use: 
```
# pseudo bash inside container
trap './checkpoint && exit 143' SIGTERM
run_job || exit 1
```
Also run a `spot-dispatcher` that watches the cloud provider's preemption webhook and proactively evicts inexpensive jobs.

maria: Also propose time-based shifting: run high-volume, low-priority jobs in off-peak windows (00:00-06:00 local). Add queue tiers: `interactive-high`, `batch-medprio`, `batch-lowprio`. Metrics to track: `preempt_rate`, `time_to_recover`, `wasted_gpu_hours`, `cost_per_gpu_hour`. Target preempt_rate <= 15% for acceptable economics; if above, reduce spot share or change regions.

infra-bot: ALERT: pipeline-embed-432 terminated due to PREEMPT at 2024-05-12T03:41:22Z — checkpoint saved to gs://rw-checkpoints/pipeline-embed-432/ckpt-7

devon: Cool. Proposed experiment: next week run in us-west1 + eu-central1 with config: baseline dedicated = 20% of capacity, spot = 60%, overflow -> dedicated when spot capacity < 10 nodes. We'll monitor `p95_latency`, `cost_per_token`, and `job_requeue_rate`. Who can own the pieces?

kai: I can own the preemptible-driver + runbook. I'll add a dashboard: `spot_pctl.recovery_time`, `gpu_util`, `preempt_rate` by region and queue. I'll also add labels `spot=true` and `preemptible=true` to nodes for easy selection.

sophie: I'll update the scheduler and job definitions, add taints/tolerations and queue mapping. Example k8s snippet for toleration/affinity: 
```
tolerations:
- key: "spot"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "true"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: "preemptible"
          operator: "In"
          values:
          - "true"
```

maria: I'll own off-peak job routing and the queue priority rules + validation suite to ensure we don't accidentally push interactive jobs to spot. Also will set up a weekly cost report comparing spot vs dedicated.

devon: Action items summary: kai = preempt-handler + runbook + dashboard; sophie = scheduler changes + labels/taints; maria = off-peak routing + validation + cost reports; devon = coordinate experiment and monitor. Aim to start rolling 2024-06-01. :thumbsup:
